title: Test Novel
text: Elizabeth Bennet was a woman of strong opinions and quick wit. She lived at Longbourn with her family. Her close friend Charlotte Lucas often visited. Elizabeth found Mr. Darcy to be proud and disagreeable at first, though he was wealthy.

title: Test Novel
text: Mr. Darcy admired Elizabeth greatly, though he struggled to express it. He was master of Pemberley, a grand estate. His friend Mr. Bingley was more amiable and fell in love with Jane Bennet, Elizabeth's sister.

title: Test Novel
text: Charlotte Lucas, being practical, married Mr. Collins for security rather than love. Elizabeth disapproved of this decision but remained loyal to her friend. She valued honesty above all else.
